verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS transcription API, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no telemetry or tracking opt-out control. The nearest items cover other things: a private-job mode that redacts the input URL and deletes segments after 12 hours (data retention), and a no-training policy (model training). Neither is an opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking, so both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
